visual_prior_specs.name: row_col_intersection_overlay
visual_prior_specs.content_description: An overlay on the provided 4x4 table image demonstrating the intersection of row C and column Q3.
visual_prior_specs.draw_instructions: Draw a semi-transparent horizontal highlight band across the entire row labeled 'C'. Draw a semi-transparent vertical highlight band down the entire column labeled 'Q3'. Draw a distinct solid dot exactly at the center of the cell where the two highlight bands intersect.
visual_prior_specs.visual_rationale: Demonstrates the spatial concept of row and column bands intersecting to isolate a single target cell, clarifying the exact visual boundaries and center point without relying on prose.
visual_encodings: Horizontal semi-transparent band = target row extent
Vertical semi-transparent band = target column extent
Solid dot = center of the intersecting target cell
text_exclusions: Do not write 'Row C' or 'Column Q3' on the overlay itself; let the original image labels show through.
Do not add explanatory text about how intersection works.

text_to_visual_binding: The horizontal band corresponds to the row specified in the task.
The vertical band corresponds to the column specified in the task.
The intersection dot represents the final output location of the target cell.
task_binding_rules: Identify the row label matching the target row.
Identify the column label matching the target column.
Trace the row horizontally and the column vertically to their intersection.
anti_leakage_rules: Do not hardcode 'C' or 'Q3' in the execution steps; use generic 'target_row' and 'target_column' parameters.

usage_constraints: The table must have clear row and column labels.
The table must be a regular grid without complex merged cells spanning the target intersection.
